name: clawd-sidekick
description: Clawd's pixel world above your prompt, in four scenes that follow your local time, season and holidays: Clawd walks to the zone of whatever Claude is doing while his crew plays, and acts out what happens: tests, commits, pushes, permission asks, a library that fills with the context. Clawds from your other sessions drop by. A Clawd spinner, 79 trophies with hats and pals to earn, a card of your day to share, live usage figures, the to-dos Claude hands you, and a deadline radar. English and 繁體中文.
